column1: # PLAT-36 corpus — the hand-maintained half. `manifest.tsv` is what a program
# computes; this is what a human writes, and it is the milestone's *"named in
# the repo with their source and revision"*.
# `fetch-corpus.py --verify` re-downloads every row at its pinned commit and
# compares the SHA-256 against the committed bytes. It needs the network and is
# deliberately NOT in any lane: a gate that depends on github.com reddens when
# github.com is slow. The lane's reproducibility is the committed bytes.
# THESE ARE NOT EIGHTEEN INDIVIDUALS' DOTFILES, and saying so is the point.
# They are eighteen real, published Vim script files that a user sources as
# configuration, from four upstreams with four clear licences. The alternative
# — eighteen dotfiles repositories scraped by popularity — was refused because
# most carry no licence at all, so redistributing them here would be a guess,
# and because their DISTRIBUTION is narrower than this set's: they are
# overwhelmingly the same `<leader>`-and-`:command<CR>` shape. This set spans a
# pure key-to-key remap with no Vimscript at all, pure `<Plug>` indirection,
# mouse events, `set`-only files with no mapping line, a file that is mostly an
# `unmap` teardown block, and two large personal configurations.
